scriptLines: bronce derive(          DemandaId = iif(isNull(DemandaId), toString(null()), upper(trim(DemandaId))),

FechaServicio = iif(isNull(FechaServicio) || trim(FechaServicio) == '', toDate(null()), iif(regexMatch(trim(FechaServicio), '^\\d{5}(\\.\\d+)?$'), addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(regexExtract(trim(FechaServicio), '(\\d+)', 1))), iif(instr(trim(FechaServicio), '/') > 0, toDate(left(trim(FechaServicio), 10), 'dd/MM/yyyy'), toDate(left(trim(FechaServicio), 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd')))),

RutaHistoricaId = iif(isNull(RutaHistoricaId) || trim(RutaHistoricaId) == '', toString(null()), iif(regexMatch(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), '^RH-'), upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), iif(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)) == 'R12-N', 'RH-12-N', iif(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)) == 'R12-S', 'RH-12-S', iif(lpad(replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA ', ''), 'R-', ''), ' ', ''), 2, '0') == '07', 'RH-07-OLD', iif(lpad(replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA ', ''), 'R-', ''), ' ', ''), 2, '0') == '12', 'RH-12-OLD', concat('RH-', lpad(replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA ', ''), 'R-', ''), ' ', ''), 2, '0')))))))),

claves derive(          DemandaId = iif(isNull(DemandaId) || not(regexMatch(DemandaId, '^DM-\\d{4}-\\d{5}$')), concat('DM-', trim(AnioFuente), '-', lpad(toString(Correlativo), 5, '0')), DemandaId)) ~> conid

conid filter(regexMatch(DemandaId, '^DM-\\d{4}-\\d{5}$') && not(isNull(FechaServicio)) && not(isNull(RutaHistoricaId)) && regexMatch(RutaHistoricaId, '^RH-') && ParadaHistoricaId != '' && regexMatch(Franja, '^\\d{2}:\\d{2}-\\d{2}:\\d{2}$') && not(isNull(ValidacionesTarjeta)) && not(isNull(Descensos)) && not(isNull(DemandaNoAtendida)) && Metodo != '') ~> validos
